Both lavapipes count 1 at pixel (0, 0) and 3 at the others, in both legs: lavapipe's clipper emits the triangle clipped to the viewport as a fan of triangles (Mesa's draw module, draw_pipe_clip.c emit_poly, with no guard band for triangles), so the quad on the fan's seam runs once per piece, each with the other piece's pixels as helpers (D315 item 10). Metal permits a partly occupied quad, so lavapipe's answer is one Metal allows, not the M3 Max's; no Vulkan mechanism keeps the clipped triangle one primitive. Open until an exact emulation exists (the user's decision of 2026-10-06): the mismatch stays counted, its reason naming the gap.

sign_off.decision: C3 answer gap: lavapipe shades a triangle it clips as several, splitting a quad on the seam; open until an exact emulation exists (the user's decision of 2026-10-06)
